name: Platinum Vape Live Resin Disposable | FPOG
description: Fruity, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. Platinum’s P1 All-In-One FPOG delivers a candy-sweet blend of tropical fruit and berry flavors with a smooth, creamy finish. The hybrid effects hit both sides—an uplifting, euphoric head buzz paired with mellow body relaxation that never gets too heavy. Pre-charged and ready to go, the P1 device makes enjoying this fan-favorite strain simple and convenient anywhere you are.
